definition: Familial Turner syndrome is an older name for Noonan syndrome, a genetically varied biological disorder that can affect males and females with normal chromosomes. It involves a pattern of physical and hormonal differences, often including short stature, neck webbing, facial and skeletal differences, heart abnormalities, and sometimes some degree of intellectual disability, with features that resemble Turner syndrome.
